(NYSE American: LGPS) (the “Company” or “LogProstyle”), headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan, today announced that it has paid the first quarterly installment of the cash dividend declared by its Board of Directors on July 13, 2026. The payment, in the amount of US$0.0115 per share, or US$271,525 in aggregate, represents the first installment of the previously announced cash dividend of US$0.046 per share, or US$1,086,047 in aggregate.

The first installment was paid on August 31, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on July 31, 2026. The ex-dividend date for market transactions was July 31, 2026, the same date as the record date. Depending on each shareholder’s financial institution and its remittance processing procedures, the actual date funds are received may vary by several business days from the payment date stated above.
The remaining quarterly installments relating to the previously announced US$0.046 per share dividend are scheduled as follows:
The Company has applied Japanese withholding tax at a uniform rate of 15.315% to the first installment payment described above.

Shareholders who are not subject to the Company’s withholding obligation — namely Japanese residents and domestic corporations — may apply for a refund. Details of the application procedure and the required forms are set out in the Japanese-language version of this release and on the Company’s website.

Forward-looking statements speak only as of the date they are made and the Company undertakes no obligation to update or revise any forward-looking statements to reflect events or circumstances after the date of this press release, except as required by applicable law. Any references to our website have been provided as a convenience, and the information contained on such website is not incorporated by reference into this press release.

LogProstyle Inc. is involved in a wide range of businesses, including real estate development, hotel management, and restaurant management. With the slogan “redefine life style,” the Company is working on various projects with the aim of illustrating an innovative and sustainable lifestyles. LogProstyle is the first unlisted Japanese company to list its Japanese common shares directly on a major United States stock exchange rather than through American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
